scripts.build: node scripts/governance/check-workspace-contract.mjs --validate && pnpm --filter @hospital/workspace-web run build && pnpm --filter @hospital/gateway run build

scripts.typecheck: tsc --project tsconfig.json --noEmit && pnpm --filter @hospital/workspace-web run typecheck && pnpm --filter @hospital/gateway run typecheck
